# ThemisDB Tests CMakeLists.txt
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)

# Check if we're building tests
if(NOT THEMIS_BUILD_TESTS)
    message(STATUS "Tests disabled")
    return()
endif()

message(STATUS "Configuring ThemisDB test suite")

# Per team policy: suppress warnings for test builds only.
# Core/library targets keep their warning policy unchanged.
if(MSVC)
    # Avoid adding a second /W flag if one is already present in the
    # global CMake flags (e.g. /W4 set by the project). Only add /W0 per
    # test target when no /W flag is present to prevent cl D9025 warnings.
    if(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS MATCHES "/W[0-4]" OR CMAKE_C_FLAGS MATCHES "/W[0-4]")
        set(_THEMIS_TESTS_SUPPRESS_WARNINGS_MVC_ALREADY_SET ON)
        message(STATUS "MSVC: global warning level already set; not forcing /W0 for tests")
    else()
        set(_THEMIS_TESTS_SUPPRESS_WARNINGS_MVC ON)
        message(STATUS "MSVC: compiler warnings will be suppressed per-test target (/W0)")
    endif()
elseif(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang|GNU")
    # For non-MSVC compilers suppress warnings per-target as well.
    set(_THEMIS_TESTS_SUPPRESS_WARNINGS_UNIX ON)
    message(STATUS "Compiler warnings will be suppressed per-test target")
endif()

include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/cmake/TestPolicy.cmake)
include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/cmake/RegisterModuleTests.cmake)

# Global output directory for all test binaries → prefer shared bin_out when available
if(DEFINED _themis_bin_out)
    set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${_themis_bin_out}")
else()
    # Fallback for older configure flows
    set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin")
endif()

# Prefer isolating module-focused tests into per-module subdirectories to avoid
# concurrent linking/writing into the same `bin_out` path which can trigger
# LNK1104 when multiple parallel linkers race on the same filename.
set(THEMIS_TESTS_RUNTIME_SUBDIR "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin_out_tests_by_module" CACHE PATH "Per-module test binary output base dir")
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${THEMIS_TESTS_RUNTIME_SUBDIR}")

# Helper: set per-target runtime output to a module-scoped folder
function(themis_set_test_out_dir target module_name)
    if(NOT TARGET ${target})
        return()
    endif()
    set(_outdir "${THEMIS_TESTS_RUNTIME_SUBDIR}/${module_name}")
    file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${_outdir}")
    set_target_properties(${target} PROPERTIES
        RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${_outdir}"
        RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_DEBUG "${_outdir}/Debug"
        RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_RELEASE "${_outdir}/Release"
        RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_RELWITHDEBINFO "${_outdir}/RelWithDebInfo"
        RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_MINSIZEREL "${_outdir}/MinSizeRel"
    )
endfunction()
if(MSVC)
    message(STATUS "MSVC Runtime: ${CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY}")
endif()

# Auto-discover modularized test folders under tests/<module>/CMakeLists.txt.
# integration is added separately with an explicit binary directory below.
file(GLOB _TEST_MODULE_CMAKES
    CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    RELATIVE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}"
    "*/CMakeLists.txt"
)
list(SORT _TEST_MODULE_CMAKES)
foreach(_module_cmake IN LISTS _TEST_MODULE_CMAKES)
    get_filename_component(_module_dir "${_module_cmake}" DIRECTORY)
    if(_module_dir STREQUAL "cmake" OR
       _module_dir STREQUAL "integration" OR
       _module_dir STREQUAL "fixtures" OR
       _module_dir STREQUAL "data" OR
       _module_dir STREQUAL "config" OR
       _module_dir STREQUAL "epic1_retrieval" OR
       _module_dir STREQUAL "epic2_evaluation" OR
       _module_dir STREQUAL "epic3_distributed_tensor")
        continue()
    endif()
    if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${_module_dir}/CMakeLists.txt")
        add_subdirectory("${_module_dir}")
    endif()
endforeach()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Post-fix: ensure test/module executables write into per-target folders to avoid
# concurrent write/copy collisions (prevents LNK1104 when applocal or parallel
# link/copy operations target the same path).
get_property(_all_targets GLOBAL PROPERTY TARGETS)
foreach(_t IN LISTS _all_targets)
    if(_t MATCHES "^(test_|module_)")
        # skip library targets and only adjust executables
        if(TARGET ${_t} AND NOT "${_t}" STREQUAL "themis_tests")
            get_target_property(_type ${_t} TYPE)
            if(_type STREQUAL "EXECUTABLE")
                set_target_properties(${_t} PROPERTIES
                    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin_out_tests/${_t}"
                    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_DEBUG "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin_out_tests/${_t}/Debug"
                    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_RELEASE "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin_out_tests/${_t}/Release"
                    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_RELWITHDEBINFO "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin_out_tests/${_t}/RelWithDebInfo"
                    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_MINSIZEREL "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin_out_tests/${_t}/MinSizeRel"
                )
            endif()
        endif()
    endif()
endforeach()

# the actual linking until after the aggregated `themis_tests` target is
# created. Calling `target_link_libraries` before the target exists
# triggers a configure-time error when CMake regenerates during build.
if(TARGET themis_core)
    set(_THEMIS_HAVE_THEMIS_CORE_FOR_TESTS TRUE)
    message(STATUS "themis_core available for tests; will link after themis_tests target creation")
endif()

# Data selection pipeline tests belong to the legal training feature, not LLM.
# When THEMIS_ENABLE_LLM is OFF its broad ".*test_lora.*\.cpp$" exclusion would
# incorrectly exclude lora/test_lora_data_selection.cpp, so we add it back explicitly
# when legal training is enabled.
if(NOT THEMIS_ENABLE_LLM AND THEMIS_ENABLE_LEGAL_TRAINING)
    # Re-include: remove the data-selection and training-pipeline e2e tests from
    # the LLM-based exclusion list by explicitly adding them back to ALL_TEST_SOURCES.
    # (list(FILTER ÔÇª EXCLUDE) has already run; we add them back before the
    # add_executable call.)
    list(APPEND ALL_TEST_SOURCES
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lora/test_lora_data_selection.cpp"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/training/test_training_pipeline_e2e.cpp"
        # Phase 3 training tests - not LLM-dependent

# Enforce feature-gated exclusions on the resolved target source list as a
# defensive step (handles late target_sources() additions in this file).
get_target_property(_themis_tests_sources themis_tests SOURCES)
if(_themis_tests_sources)
    list(FILTER _themis_tests_sources EXCLUDE REGEX ".*[\\/]test_feature_flags\\.cpp$")
    list(FILTER _themis_tests_sources EXCLUDE REGEX ".*[\\/]test_vulkan_compute_equivalents\\.cpp$")
    list(FILTER _themis_tests_sources EXCLUDE REGEX ".*[\\/]chimera[\\/]test_themisdb_adapter\\.cpp$")
    list(FILTER _themis_tests_sources EXCLUDE REGEX ".*[\\/]chimera[\\/]test_chimera_prepared_statements\\.cpp$")
    list(FILTER _themis_tests_sources EXCLUDE REGEX ".*[\\/]chimera[\\/]test_chimera_streaming\\.cpp$")
    # Prevent duplicate protobuf descriptor registration at runtime:
    # themis_wire_v1.pb.cc is provided via themis_network; compiling it again
    # into themis_tests causes FATAL "File already exists in database".
    list(FILTER _themis_tests_sources EXCLUDE REGEX ".*[\\/]proto_generated[\\/]themis_wire_v1\\.pb\\.cc$")
    list(FILTER _themis_tests_sources EXCLUDE REGEX ".*[\\/]src[\\/]importers[\\/]postgres_importer\\.cpp$")
    list(FILTER _themis_tests_sources EXCLUDE REGEX ".*[\\/]src[\\/]importers[\\/]postgres_importer_mdm\\.cpp$")
    if(NOT THEMIS_ENABLE_GPU)
        list(FILTER _themis_tests_sources EXCLUDE REGEX ".*[\\/]test_cpu_gpu_parity\\.cpp$")
    endif()
    set_property(TARGET themis_tests PROPERTY SOURCES ${_themis_tests_sources})
endif()

# Re-include context/test_context_propagation.cpp excluded by the catch-all pattern above.

# safety, and multi-thread isolation).  It has no GPU or LLM dependencies; the
# previous exclusion was due to context_propagation.cpp being absent from the build
# graph (the thread_local definition was not compiled in).  Now that the source file

# re-include unconditionally.

    )

if(THEMIS_BUILD_MODULAR)
    if(DEFINED THEMIS_CORE_SOURCES AND THEMIS_CORE_SOURCES)
        message(STATUS "THEMIS_BUILD_MODULAR=ON: building themis_tests with THEMIS_CORE_SOURCES for full symbol coverage")
        set(_themis_test_core_sources ${THEMIS_CORE_SOURCES})
        if(TARGET themis_sharding)
            list(FILTER _themis_test_core_sources EXCLUDE REGEX ".*/src/sharding/.*\\.cpp$")
            list(FILTER _themis_test_core_sources EXCLUDE REGEX ".*/src/server/rpc/blob_transfer_handler\\.cpp$")
            list(FILTER _themis_test_core_sources EXCLUDE REGEX ".*/src/utils/tracing\\.cpp$")
            message(STATUS "themis_tests: excluding direct sharding sources (provided by themis_sharding module)")
        endif()
        list(FILTER _themis_test_core_sources EXCLUDE REGEX ".*/src/server/http_server\\.cpp>?$")
        list(FILTER _themis_test_core_sources EXCLUDE REGEX ".*[\\\\/]src[\\\\/]server[\\\\/]http_server\\.cpp>?$")
        if(NOT THEMIS_ENABLE_POSTGRES_WIRE)
            list(REMOVE_ITEM _themis_test_core_sources
                ../src/server/import_api_handler.cpp
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/server/import_api_handler.cpp
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/server/import_api_handler.cpp
            )
        endif()
        list(FILTER _themis_test_core_sources EXCLUDE REGEX ".*/src/security/stubs\\.cpp$")
        list(FILTER _themis_test_core_sources EXCLUDE REGEX ".*/src/stubs\\.cpp$")
        list(FILTER _themis_test_core_sources EXCLUDE REGEX ".*/src/security/pii_redaction_policy\\.cpp$")
        if(TARGET themis_llm)
            # Exclude all sources compiled into themis_llm's unity build to avoid LNK2005.
            # _themis_test_core_sources contains relative paths (../src/foo/bar.cpp), so we
            # match on the path SUFFIX only — no absolute-path prefix needed.
            # The regex "." matches any char, covering both / and \ separators.
            # src/llm/ — all files (direct + lora_framework subdir)
            list(FILTER _themis_test_core_sources EXCLUDE REGEX "src.llm..*\\.cpp$")
            # src/prompt_engineering/ — entire directory is owned by THEMIS_LLM_SOURCES
            list(FILTER _themis_test_core_sources EXCLUDE REGEX "src.prompt_engineering..*\\.cpp$")
            # src/cache/embedding_cache.cpp
            list(FILTER _themis_test_core_sources EXCLUDE REGEX "src.cache.embedding_cache\\.cpp$")
            # src/security/vram_secure_clear.cpp
            list(FILTER _themis_test_core_sources EXCLUDE REGEX "src.security.vram_secure_clear\\.cpp$")
            # src/distributed_knowledge/ — LLM-owned files
            list(FILTER _themis_test_core_sources EXCLUDE REGEX "src.distributed_knowledge.(cross_shard_feedback_sync|adapter_capability_announcement)\\.cpp$")
            # src/aql/ — LLM-owned AQL support files
            list(FILTER _themis_test_core_sources EXCLUDE REGEX "src.aql.(llm_aql_embedding_bridge|llm_aql_handler|aql_query_validator|aql_query_builder|aql_schema_provider|aql_fewshot_example_library|aql_syntax_highlighter|aql_confidence_scorer|llm_metrics_collector)\\.cpp$")
            # src/rag/ — LLM-owned RAG evaluator/enhancement files in THEMIS_LLM_SOURCES
            list(FILTER _themis_test_core_sources EXCLUDE REGEX "src.rag.(knowledge_gap_detector|llm_integration|llm_judge_client|llm_judge_integration|nli_faithfulness_verifier|quality_control_pipeline|prompt_templates|response_parser|faithfulness_evaluator|relevance_evaluator|completeness_evaluator|coherence_evaluator|geval_evaluator|rag_judge|reranker|document_summarizer|document_splitter|hybrid_retriever|lora_enhanced_retriever|citation_highlighter|distributed_rag_evaluator|prompt_injection_detector|evaluation_report_exporter|evaluation_cache|calibration_manager|batch_evaluator|bias_detector|adversarial_tester|multimodal_rag|ab_testing_framework|agentic_rag|bayesian_optimizer|claim_extractor|continuous_learning_client|continuous_learning_orchestrator|cot_evaluator|hallucination_dashboard|http_metrics_client|judge_config|judge_ensemble|knowledge_graph_retriever|learning_metrics|llm_meta_analyzer|onnx_model_loader|pairwise_comparator|quality_control_factory|rubric_evaluator|streaming_retriever)\\.cpp$")
            # src/training/ — LLM-owned training files in THEMIS_LLM_SOURCES
            list(FILTER _themis_test_core_sources EXCLUDE REGEX "src.training.(lora_data_selection|incremental_lora_trainer|lora_checkpoint_manager|adapter_serving)\\.cpp$")
            # src/server/ — LLM API handlers
            list(FILTER _themis_test_core_sources EXCLUDE REGEX "src.server.(llm_api_handler|lora_api_handler)\\.cpp$")
            message(STATUS "themis_tests: excluding LLM module sources from direct compilation (provided by themis_llm)")
        endif()
        if(TARGET themis_network)
            # graphql.cpp and themisdb_grpc_service.cpp are compiled into themis_network
            # (as static or shared lib).  Exclude them from _themis_test_core_sources to
            # avoid LNK2005 duplicate definitions.  Generator-expression entries end with
            # ">", so the regex uses ">?$" to match both plain and GE-wrapped paths.
            list(FILTER _themis_test_core_sources EXCLUDE REGEX ".*[\\\\/]src[\\\\/]api[\\\\/]graphql\\.cpp>?$")
            list(FILTER _themis_test_core_sources EXCLUDE REGEX ".*/src/api/graphql\\.cpp>?$")
            list(FILTER _themis_test_core_sources EXCLUDE REGEX ".*[\\\\/]src[\\\\/]api[\\\\/]themisdb_grpc_service\\.cpp>?$")
            list(FILTER _themis_test_core_sources EXCLUDE REGEX ".*/src/api/themisdb_grpc_service\\.cpp>?$")
        endif()
        if(TARGET themis_storage)
            # Exclude schema_migration / updates sources that are already compiled
            # into themis_storage.dll.  Including them again in themis_tests would
            # create an ODR violation: two copies of SchemaMigration::Impl with
            # anonymous-namespace types, causing silent virtual-dispatch failures.
            list(FILTER _themis_test_core_sources EXCLUDE REGEX ".*/src/updates/schema_migration\\.cpp$")
            list(FILTER _themis_test_core_sources EXCLUDE REGEX ".*/src/updates/schema_migration_tester\\.cpp$")
            list(FILTER _themis_test_core_sources EXCLUDE REGEX ".*[\\\\/]src[\\\\/]updates[\\\\/]schema_migration\\.cpp$")
            list(FILTER _themis_test_core_sources EXCLUDE REGEX ".*[\\\\/]src[\\\\/]updates[\\\\/]schema_migration_tester\\.cpp$")
            message(STATUS "themis_tests: excluding direct schema_migration sources (provided by themis_storage module)")
        endif()
        # NOTE: logger.cpp / license_info.cpp / build_info.cpp are intentionally kept
        # in the test sources.  The test binary defines THEMIS_BASE_EXPORTS (so the
        # compiler sees Logger as __declspec(dllexport)), which means the static-member
        # definition *must* come from a locally compiled .cpp.  Excluding them causes
        # LNK2001 (logger_ undefined). The resulting LNK2005 overlap with themis_base.dll
        # is suppressed via /FORCE:MULTIPLE on the test linker (see below).
        if(TARGET themis_network)
            get_target_property(_themis_network_target_type_for_sources themis_network TYPE)
            if(_themis_network_target_type_for_sources STREQUAL "STATIC_LIBRARY")
                # Robust path filters for both '/' and '\\' separators.
                list(FILTER _themis_test_core_sources EXCLUDE REGEX ".*[\\\\/]src[\\\\/]server[\\\\/].*\\.cpp>?$")
                list(FILTER _themis_test_core_sources EXCLUDE REGEX ".*[\\\\/]src[\\\\/]network[\\\\/].*\\.cpp>?$")
                list(FILTER _themis_test_core_sources EXCLUDE REGEX ".*[\\\\/]src[\\\\/]maintenance[\\\\/].*\\.cpp>?$")
                list(FILTER _themis_test_core_sources EXCLUDE REGEX ".*[\\\\/]src[\\\\/]scheduler[\\\\/].*\\.cpp>?$")
                list(FILTER _themis_test_core_sources EXCLUDE REGEX ".*[\\\\/]src[\\\\/]observability[\\\\/]alertmanager\\.cpp>?$")
                list(FILTER _themis_test_core_sources EXCLUDE REGEX ".*[\\\\/]proto_generated[\\\\/]themis_.*\\.pb\\.cc>?$")
                list(FILTER _themis_test_core_sources EXCLUDE REGEX ".*[\\\\/]proto_generated[\\\\/]themisdb(\\.grpc)?\\.pb\\.cc>?$")
                message(STATUS "themis_tests: excluding direct server/network/maintenance sources (provided by static themis_network module)")
            endif()
        endif()
        # ==========================================================
        # PERMANENT FIX: Dynamic module-source deduplication.
        # Collects all source basenames owned by any existing module
        # and removes matching entries from _themis_test_core_sources.
        # This automatically handles future additions to module source
        # lists without requiring manual filter maintenance.
        # ==========================================================
        set(_module_owned_basenames)
        foreach(_dedup_mod
                themis_base themis_storage themis_security themis_transaction
            themis_sharding themis_llm themis_llm_ext themis_query themis_timeseries
                themis_graph themis_geo themis_content themis_network)
            if(TARGET ${_dedup_mod})
                get_target_property(_dedup_mod_type ${_dedup_mod} TYPE)
                if(_dedup_mod_type STREQUAL "STATIC_LIBRARY")
                    get_target_property(_dedup_srcs ${_dedup_mod} SOURCES)
                    if(_dedup_srcs)
                        foreach(_ds IN LISTS _dedup_srcs)
                            # Skip generator expressions — they resolve at build time
                            if(NOT _ds MATCHES "^\\$<")
                                get_filename_component(_bn "${_ds}" NAME)
                                list(APPEND _module_owned_basenames "${_bn}")
                            endif()
                        endforeach()
                    endif()
                endif()
            endif()
        endforeach()
        if(_module_owned_basenames)
            list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES _module_owned_basenames)
            set(_dedup_core)
            foreach(_cs IN LISTS _themis_test_core_sources)
                get_filename_component(_bn "${_cs}" NAME)
                if(NOT "${_bn}" IN_LIST _module_owned_basenames)
                    list(APPEND _dedup_core "${_cs}")
                endif()
            endforeach()
            set(_themis_test_core_sources ${_dedup_core})
            message(STATUS "themis_tests: dynamic module-dedup applied to core sources")
        endif()
        target_sources(themis_tests PRIVATE ${_themis_test_core_sources})
        target_compile_definitions(themis_tests PRIVATE
            THEMIS_BASE_EXPORTS
            THEMIS_STORAGE_EXPORTS
            THEMIS_SECURITY_EXPORTS
            THEMIS_TRANSACTION_EXPORTS
            THEMIS_SHARDING_EXPORTS
            THEMIS_LLM_EXPORTS
            THEMIS_QUERY_EXPORTS
            THEMIS_TIMESERIES_EXPORTS
            THEMIS_GRAPH_EXPORTS
            THEMIS_GEO_EXPORTS
            THEMIS_CONTENT_EXPORTS
            THEMIS_NETWORK_EXPORTS
            THEMIS_IMAGE_PLUGIN_DISABLE_EXPORT
        )

        set(_themis_test_extra_sources

        if(NOT THEMIS_ENABLE_POSTGRES_WIRE)

                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/server/import_api_handler.cpp

        endif()

        # test_hsm_provider_stub defines g_hsm_provider. When themis_network is
        # linked as static library, it already provides hsm_provider_global.cpp,
        # which exports the same symbol and would trigger LNK2005.
        # pitr_manager.cpp is also in themis_network (THEMIS_ENABLE_HTTP_SERVER path);
        # remove it from extra_sources to avoid duplicate symbol errors.
        if(TARGET themis_network)
            get_target_property(_themis_network_target_type_stub themis_network TYPE)
            if(_themis_network_target_type_stub STREQUAL "STATIC_LIBRARY")
                list(REMOVE_ITEM _themis_test_extra_sources
                    ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/tests/hsm/test_hsm_provider_stub.cpp

                    ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/storage/pitr_manager.cpp
                )
            endif()
        endif()

        if(THEMIS_ENABLE_GPU AND NOT TARGET themis_llm)
            list(APPEND _themis_test_extra_sources
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/llm/lora_framework/gpu_tensor.cpp
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/llm/lora_framework/vram_allocator.cpp
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/llm/lora_framework/gpu_lora_layers.cpp
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/llm/lora_framework/paged_memory_manager.cpp
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/llm/lora_framework/custom_allreduce.cpp
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/llm/lora_framework/multi_gpu.cpp
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/llm/lora_framework/multi_gpu_trainer.cpp
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/llm/lora_framework/multi_gpu_lora_layer.cpp
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/index/gpu_vector_index.cpp
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/index/multi_gpu_vector_index.cpp
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/gpu/cuda_operations.cpp
            )

        endif()

## Add cuda_operations.cpp only when CUDA headers are actually available
## to avoid forcing compilation on machines without the CUDA Toolkit.
find_path(_CUDA_RUNTIME_HEADER cuda_runtime.h)
if(_CUDA_RUNTIME_HEADER)
    message(STATUS "CUDA headers found; adding cuda_operations.cpp to themis_tests")
    target_sources(themis_tests PRIVATE ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/gpu/cuda_operations.cpp)
else()
    message(STATUS "Skipping cuda_operations.cpp for themis_tests (CUDA headers not found)")
    # Add a CUDA-free stub implementation so tests that exercise move semantics
    # can still link on machines without the CUDA Toolkit.
    target_sources(themis_tests PRIVATE ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/gpu/cuda_operations_stub.cpp)
endif()
        # Also filter _themis_test_extra_sources against module-owned basenames.
        # Absolute paths in extra_sources don't match relative paths in
        # THEMIS_CORE_SOURCES (string mismatch), so the loop's FIND check alone
        # is insufficient. Basename matching covers both path formats.
        if(_module_owned_basenames)
            set(_dedup_extra)
            foreach(_es IN LISTS _themis_test_extra_sources)
                if(_es MATCHES "^\\$<")
                    # Preserve generator expressions unchanged
                    list(APPEND _dedup_extra "${_es}")
                else()
                    get_filename_component(_bn "${_es}" NAME)
                    if(NOT "${_bn}" IN_LIST _module_owned_basenames)
                        list(APPEND _dedup_extra "${_es}")
                    endif()
                endif()
            endforeach()
            set(_themis_test_extra_sources ${_dedup_extra})
            message(STATUS "themis_tests: dynamic module-dedup applied to extra sources")
        endif()
        foreach(_extra_src IN LISTS _themis_test_extra_sources)
            if(EXISTS "${_extra_src}")
                list(FIND THEMIS_CORE_SOURCES "${_extra_src}" _extra_src_idx)
                if(_extra_src_idx EQUAL -1)
                    target_sources(themis_tests PRIVATE "${_extra_src}")
                endif()
            endif()
        endforeach()
        # When themis_llm module is NOT available, add the LLM subsystem sources
        # that are not in THEMIS_CORE_SOURCES but required by LLM tests.
        if(NOT TARGET themis_llm)
            foreach(_llm_src
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/llm/adapter_registry.cpp
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/llm/ai_decision_auditor.cpp
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/llm/explanation_generator.cpp
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/llm/kernel_fusion.cpp
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/llm/model_metadata_cache.cpp
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/llm/lora_metadata_cache.cpp

                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/llm/lora_framework/lora_feedback_storage.cpp
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/llm/lora_framework/lora_training_config.cpp
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/llm/lora_framework/lora_audit_logger.cpp
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/llm/lora_framework/feedback_plugin.cpp
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/llm/security/signature_verifier.cpp

        foreach(_mod
            themis_base

    else()
        foreach(_mod
            themis_base
            themis_storage
            themis_security
            themis_transaction
            themis_sharding
            themis_llm
            themis_llm_ext
            themis_query
            themis_timeseries
            themis_graph
            themis_geo

# Final defensive pruning after all themis_tests target_sources() additions.
get_target_property(_themis_tests_sources_final themis_tests SOURCES)
if(_themis_tests_sources_final)
    list(FILTER _themis_tests_sources_final EXCLUDE REGEX ".*[\\/]test_feature_flags\\.cpp$")
    list(FILTER _themis_tests_sources_final EXCLUDE REGEX ".*[\\/]test_vulkan_compute_equivalents\\.cpp$")
    list(FILTER _themis_tests_sources_final EXCLUDE REGEX ".*[\\/]chimera[\\/]test_chimera_prepared_statements\\.cpp$")
    list(FILTER _themis_tests_sources_final EXCLUDE REGEX ".*[\\/]chimera[\\/]test_chimera_streaming\\.cpp$")
    list(FILTER _themis_tests_sources_final EXCLUDE REGEX ".*[\\/]proto_generated[\\/]themis_wire_v1\\.pb\\.cc$")
    if(TARGET themis_network)
        get_target_property(_themis_network_target_type_final themis_network TYPE)
        if(_themis_network_target_type_final STREQUAL "STATIC_LIBRARY")
            list(FILTER _themis_tests_sources_final EXCLUDE REGEX ".*[\\\\/]src[\\\\/]server[\\\\/].*\\.cpp>?$")
            list(FILTER _themis_tests_sources_final EXCLUDE REGEX ".*[\\\\/]src[\\\\/]network[\\\\/].*\\.cpp>?$")
            list(FILTER _themis_tests_sources_final EXCLUDE REGEX ".*[\\\\/]src[\\\\/]maintenance[\\\\/].*\\.cpp>?$")
            list(FILTER _themis_tests_sources_final EXCLUDE REGEX ".*[\\\\/]src[\\\\/]scheduler[\\\\/].*\\.cpp>?$")
            list(FILTER _themis_tests_sources_final EXCLUDE REGEX ".*[\\\\/]src[\\\\/]observability[\\\\/]alertmanager\\.cpp>?$")
            list(FILTER _themis_tests_sources_final EXCLUDE REGEX ".*[\\\\/]src[\\\\/]storage[\\\\/]pitr_manager\\.cpp>?$")
            list(FILTER _themis_tests_sources_final EXCLUDE REGEX ".*[\\\\/]tests[\\\\/]test_hsm_provider_stub\\.cpp>?$")
            list(FILTER _themis_tests_sources_final EXCLUDE REGEX ".*[\\\\/]proto_generated[\\\\/]themis_.*\\.pb\\.cc>?$")
            list(FILTER _themis_tests_sources_final EXCLUDE REGEX ".*[\\\\/]proto_generated[\\\\/]themisdb(\\.grpc)?\\.pb\\.cc>?$")
        endif()
    endif()
    if(NOT THEMIS_ENABLE_GPU)
        list(FILTER _themis_tests_sources_final EXCLUDE REGEX ".*[\\/]test_cpu_gpu_parity\\.cpp$")
    endif()

    # Permanent module-boundary guard:
    # Remove any directly compiled production source whose basename is already
    # owned by a linked module target. This catches duplicates introduced by
    # ad-hoc target_sources(...) additions outside _themis_test_core_sources and
    # _themis_test_extra_sources.
    set(_themis_module_owned_basenames_final)
    foreach(_dedup_mod_final
            themis_base themis_storage themis_security themis_transaction
            themis_sharding themis_llm themis_llm_ext themis_query themis_timeseries
            themis_graph themis_geo themis_content themis_network)
        if(TARGET ${_dedup_mod_final})
            get_target_property(_dedup_mod_type_final ${_dedup_mod_final} TYPE)
            if(_dedup_mod_type_final STREQUAL "STATIC_LIBRARY")
                get_target_property(_dedup_mod_srcs_final ${_dedup_mod_final} SOURCES)
                if(_dedup_mod_srcs_final)
                    foreach(_ms IN LISTS _dedup_mod_srcs_final)
                        # Generator expressions can be disabled for this build
                        # configuration. Treating all of them as active over-prunes
                        # direct sources and causes LNK2019. Keep them skipped.
                        if(NOT _ms MATCHES "^\\$<")
                            get_filename_component(_mb "${_ms}" NAME)
                            if(_mb MATCHES "\\.cpp$|\\.cc$|\\.c$|\\.cxx$")
                                list(APPEND _themis_module_owned_basenames_final "${_mb}")
                            endif()
                        endif()
                    endforeach()
                endif()
            endif()
        endif()
    endforeach()
    if(_themis_module_owned_basenames_final)
        list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES _themis_module_owned_basenames_final)
        set(_themis_tests_sources_final_dedup)
        foreach(_src_final IN LISTS _themis_tests_sources_final)
            if(_src_final MATCHES "^\\$<")
                list(APPEND _themis_tests_sources_final_dedup "${_src_final}")
            elseif(_src_final MATCHES "[\\/]tests[\\/]")
                # Always keep test translation units.
                list(APPEND _themis_tests_sources_final_dedup "${_src_final}")
            else()
                get_filename_component(_src_bn_final "${_src_final}" NAME)
                if(NOT "${_src_bn_final}" IN_LIST _themis_module_owned_basenames_final)
                    list(APPEND _themis_tests_sources_final_dedup "${_src_final}")
                endif()
            endif()
        endforeach()
        set(_themis_tests_sources_final ${_themis_tests_sources_final_dedup})
    endif()
    set_property(TARGET themis_tests PROPERTY SOURCES ${_themis_tests_sources_final})
endif()

# Keep a small whitelist of focused implementations compiled directly into the

# static themis_network module.
if(TARGET themis_network)

        target_sources(themis_tests PRIVATE
            ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/network/udp_server.cpp

        )

# FORCE-INCLUDE: logger.cpp / license_info.cpp / build_info.cpp
# The test binary sets THEMIS_BASE_EXPORTS, so all TUs that include logger.h
# see Logger as __declspec(dllexport) and reference logger_ directly (not via
# __imp_).  These three files MUST be compiled into the test binary so the
# static-member definitions are available to the linker.  The duplicate-symbol
# overlap with themis_base.dll is suppressed by /FORCE:MULTIPLE below.
get_target_property(_themis_tests_src_check themis_tests SOURCES)
foreach(_force_src
        "${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/utils/logger.cpp"
        "${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/themis/license_info.cpp"
        "${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/themis/build_info.cpp")
    if(NOT "${_force_src}" IN_LIST _themis_tests_src_check)
        target_sources(themis_tests PRIVATE "${_force_src}")
        message(STATUS "themis_tests: force-added ${_force_src} (required by THEMIS_BASE_EXPORTS)")
    endif()
endforeach()

# On Windows, disable whole program optimization (/GL) to match DLL ABI.

    target_compile_options(themis_tests PRIVATE
        $<$<CONFIG:Release>:/GL->
        $<$<CONFIG:RelWithDebInfo>:/GL->
        $<$<CONFIG:MinSizeRel>:/GL->
    )
    target_link_options(themis_tests PRIVATE
        $<$<CONFIG:Release>:/LTCG:OFF>
        $<$<CONFIG:RelWithDebInfo>:/LTCG:OFF>
        $<$<CONFIG:MinSizeRel>:/LTCG:OFF>
        # /FORCE:MULTIPLE: themis_base.dll and directly-compiled .cpp files both define
        # Logger/license/build_info symbols (because THEMIS_BASE_EXPORTS is set for the
        # test binary). The local .obj definition is used; the DLL export is secondary.
        # This is intentional and safe for a test binary.
        $<$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:MSVC>:/FORCE:MULTIPLE>
    )
endif()

# Copy DLLs to test directory on Windows after build
if(WIN32)
    function(themis_sync_runtime_dlls_for_target target_name)
        add_custom_command(TARGET ${target_name} POST_BUILD
            COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND}
                -DBIN_DIR=${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin
                -DVCPKG_BIN_DIR=${_themis_vcpkg_bin_dir}
                -DDST_DIR=$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:${target_name}>
                -P ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/cmake/CopyRuntimeDlls.cmake
            COMMENT "Syncing runtime DLLs for ${target_name}"
        )
    endfunction()

    add_custom_target(sync_test_runtime_dlls
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND}
            -DBIN_DIR=${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin
            -DVCPKG_BIN_DIR=${_themis_vcpkg_bin_dir}
            -DDST_DIR=${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/cmake/tests
            -P ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/cmake/CopyRuntimeDlls.cmake
        COMMENT "Syncing runtime DLLs to cmake/tests"
    )

    # Build-time sync avoids stale DLLs in target runtime directories.
    themis_sync_runtime_dlls_for_target(themis_tests)

    # Ensure module DLLs are built before syncing cmake/tests runtime dependencies.
    foreach(_themis_runtime_target IN ITEMS
        themis_base
        themis_content
        themis_geo
        themis_graph
        themis_ingestion
        themis_llm
        themis_network
        themis_query
        themis_security
        themis_sharding
        themis_storage
        themis_timeseries
        themis_transaction
    )
        if(TARGET ${_themis_runtime_target})
            add_dependencies(sync_test_runtime_dlls ${_themis_runtime_target})
        endif()
    endforeach()

    add_dependencies(themis_tests sync_test_runtime_dlls)
endif()

# ============================================================================
# Distributed Graph Tests
# ============================================================================

if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/graph/test_graph_distributed.cpp")
    message(STATUS "Adding Distributed Graph tests")

    # Build test_graph_distributed into standard bin/ directory
    # (custom output dirs caused Windows AppLocker/AV write blocks)

    # TEMP WORKAROUND: These targets experience LNK1104 file-lock during parallel build on Windows.
    # Build them serially: cmake --build --preset windows-release --target test_graph_distributed --parallel 1
    add_executable(test_graph_distributed EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL
        graph/test_graph_distributed.cpp
        ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/graph/graph_query_optimizer.cpp
        ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/graph/path_constraints.cpp
        ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/graph/distributed_graph.cpp
        ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/graph/parallel_traversal.cpp
    )

    target_link_libraries(test_graph_distributed PRIVATE
        ${TEST_LIBS}
        themis_core
        spdlog::spdlog
        fmt::fmt
        nlohmann_json::nlohmann_json
        RocksDB::rocksdb
        Threads::Threads
    )

    target_compile_definitions(test_graph_distributed PRIVATE
        THEMIS_TEST_BUILD=1
        THEMIS_GRAPH_EXPORTS
    )

    if(WIN32)
        # WORKAROUND: File locking on bin\tgdist.exe during parallel link phase
        # Redirect to separate output directory to avoid contention with other targets
        file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/test_outputs")
        set_target_properties(test_graph_distributed PROPERTIES 
            OUTPUT_NAME "tgdist"
            RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/test_outputs"
        )
        set_target_properties(test_graph_distributed PROPERTIES SKIP_RPATH TRUE)
    endif()

    if(FALSE)  # Disabled to avoid file-lock race on Windows
        themis_sync_runtime_dlls_for_target(test_graph_distributed)
        add_dependencies(test_graph_distributed sync_test_runtime_dlls)
    endif()

    add_test(NAME DistributedGraphTests COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:test_graph_distributed>)

    set_tests_properties(DistributedGraphTests PROPERTIES
        LABELS "graph;distributed;shards;unit"
        TIMEOUT 120
        ENVIRONMENT_MODIFICATION
            "PATH=path_list_prepend:${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin\\;${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin_out"
    )

    # TEMP WORKAROUND: These targets experience LNK1104 file-lock during parallel build on Windows.
    # Build them serially: cmake --build --preset windows-release --target test_graph_distributed_shared_mutex_focused --parallel 1
    add_executable(test_graph_distributed_shared_mutex_focused EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL
        graph/test_graph_distributed.cpp
        ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/graph/graph_query_optimizer.cpp
        ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/graph/path_constraints.cpp
        ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/graph/distributed_graph.cpp
        ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/graph/parallel_traversal.cpp
    )

    target_link_libraries(test_graph_distributed_shared_mutex_focused PRIVATE
        ${TEST_LIBS}
        themis_core
        spdlog::spdlog
        fmt::fmt
        nlohmann_json::nlohmann_json
        RocksDB::rocksdb
        Threads::Threads
    )

    target_compile_definitions(test_graph_distributed_shared_mutex_focused PRIVATE
        THEMIS_TEST_BUILD=1
        THEMIS_GRAPH_EXPORTS
    )

    if(WIN32)
        # WORKAROUND: File locking on bin\tgdsmf.exe during parallel link phase
        # Redirect to separate output directory to avoid contention with other targets
        file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/test_outputs")
        set_target_properties(test_graph_distributed_shared_mutex_focused PROPERTIES 
            OUTPUT_NAME "tgdsmf"
            RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/test_outputs"
        )
        set_target_properties(test_graph_distributed_shared_mutex_focused PROPERTIES SKIP_RPATH TRUE)
    endif()

    if(FALSE)  # Disabled to avoid file-lock race on Windows
        themis_sync_runtime_dlls_for_target(test_graph_distributed_shared_mutex_focused)
        add_dependencies(test_graph_distributed_shared_mutex_focused sync_test_runtime_dlls)
    endif()

    add_test(NAME DistributedGraphSharedMutexFocusedTests
             COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:test_graph_distributed_shared_mutex_focused>
                     --gtest_filter=DistributedGraphSharedMutexStressTest.*)

    set_tests_properties(DistributedGraphSharedMutexFocusedTests PROPERTIES
        LABELS "graph;distributed;shared_mutex;concurrency;focused;unit"
        TIMEOUT 60
        ENVIRONMENT_MODIFICATION
            "PATH=path_list_prepend:${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin\\;${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin_out"
    )

    message(STATUS "  Distributed Graph: shard-aware query execution, BFS/Dijkstra fan-out, plan generation")
else()
    message(STATUS "Distributed Graph tests not found at ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/graph/test_graph_distributed.cpp")
endif()

# Arrow Flight focused tests
if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/analytics/test_arrow_flight.cpp")
    message(STATUS "Adding focused Arrow Flight tests")

    add_executable(test_arrow_flight_focused
        analytics/test_arrow_flight.cpp
        ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/analytics/arrow_flight.cpp
        ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/analytics/arrow_export.cpp
    )

    target_include_directories(test_arrow_flight_focused PRIVATE
        ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/include
        ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src
    )

    target_link_libraries(test_arrow_flight_focused PRIVATE
        ${TEST_LIBS}
        spdlog::spdlog
        Threads::Threads
    )

    set(_themis_arrow_core_linked FALSE)
    if(DEFINED THEMIS_ARROW_TARGET AND TARGET ${THEMIS_ARROW_TARGET})
        target_link_libraries(test_arrow_flight_focused PRIVATE ${THEMIS_ARROW_TARGET})
        set(_themis_arrow_core_linked TRUE)
    elseif(TARGET Arrow::arrow_shared)
        target_link_libraries(test_arrow_flight_focused PRIVATE Arrow::arrow_shared)
        set(_themis_arrow_core_linked TRUE)
    elseif(TARGET Arrow::arrow_static)
        target_link_libraries(test_arrow_flight_focused PRIVATE Arrow::arrow_static)
        set(_themis_arrow_core_linked TRUE)
    elseif(TARGET Arrow::arrow)
        target_link_libraries(test_arrow_flight_focused PRIVATE Arrow::arrow)
        set(_themis_arrow_core_linked TRUE)
    elseif(TARGET arrow_shared)
        target_link_libraries(test_arrow_flight_focused PRIVATE arrow_shared)
        set(_themis_arrow_core_linked TRUE)
    elseif(TARGET arrow_static)
        target_link_libraries(test_arrow_flight_focused PRIVATE arrow_static)
        set(_themis_arrow_core_linked TRUE)
    elseif(TARGET arrow)
        target_link_libraries(test_arrow_flight_focused PRIVATE arrow)
        set(_themis_arrow_core_linked TRUE)
    elseif(EXISTS "${_themis_vcpkg_lib_dir}/arrow.lib")
        target_link_libraries(test_arrow_flight_focused PRIVATE "${_themis_vcpkg_lib_dir}/arrow.lib")
        set(_themis_arrow_core_linked TRUE)
    endif()

    if(_themis_arrow_core_linked)
        target_compile_definitions(test_arrow_flight_focused PRIVATE THEMIS_HAS_ARROW=1)
    endif()

    set(_themis_arrow_flight_linked FALSE)
    if(TARGET ArrowFlight::arrow_flight)
        target_link_libraries(test_arrow_flight_focused PRIVATE ArrowFlight::arrow_flight)
        set(_themis_arrow_flight_linked TRUE)
    elseif(TARGET ArrowFlight::arrow_flight_shared)
        target_link_libraries(test_arrow_flight_focused PRIVATE ArrowFlight::arrow_flight_shared)
        set(_themis_arrow_flight_linked TRUE)
    elseif(TARGET ArrowFlight::arrow_flight_static)
        target_link_libraries(test_arrow_flight_focused PRIVATE ArrowFlight::arrow_flight_static)
        set(_themis_arrow_flight_linked TRUE)
    elseif(TARGET Arrow::arrow_flight)
        target_link_libraries(test_arrow_flight_focused PRIVATE Arrow::arrow_flight)
        set(_themis_arrow_flight_linked TRUE)
    elseif(TARGET Arrow::arrow_flight_shared)
        target_link_libraries(test_arrow_flight_focused PRIVATE Arrow::arrow_flight_shared)
        set(_themis_arrow_flight_linked TRUE)
    elseif(TARGET Arrow::arrow_flight_static)
        target_link_libraries(test_arrow_flight_focused PRIVATE Arrow::arrow_flight_static)
        set(_themis_arrow_flight_linked TRUE)
    elseif(TARGET arrow_flight)
        target_link_libraries(test_arrow_flight_focused PRIVATE arrow_flight)
        set(_themis_arrow_flight_linked TRUE)
    elseif(TARGET arrow_flight_shared)
        target_link_libraries(test_arrow_flight_focused PRIVATE arrow_flight_shared)
        set(_themis_arrow_flight_linked TRUE)
    elseif(TARGET arrow_flight_static)
        target_link_libraries(test_arrow_flight_focused PRIVATE arrow_flight_static)
        set(_themis_arrow_flight_linked TRUE)
    elseif(EXISTS "${_themis_vcpkg_lib_dir}/arrow_flight.lib")
        target_link_libraries(test_arrow_flight_focused PRIVATE "${_themis_vcpkg_lib_dir}/arrow_flight.lib")
        set(_themis_arrow_flight_linked TRUE)
    endif()

    if(_themis_arrow_flight_linked)
        # Arrow Flight depends on Arrow core symbols; ensure core lib is linked if only flight was found.
        if(NOT _themis_arrow_core_linked AND EXISTS "${_themis_vcpkg_lib_dir}/arrow.lib")
            target_link_libraries(test_arrow_flight_focused PRIVATE "${_themis_vcpkg_lib_dir}/arrow.lib")
            set(_themis_arrow_core_linked TRUE)
            target_compile_definitions(test_arrow_flight_focused PRIVATE THEMIS_HAS_ARROW=1)
        endif()
        target_compile_definitions(test_arrow_flight_focused PRIVATE THEMIS_HAS_ARROW_FLIGHT=1)
    endif()

    if(NOT _themis_arrow_flight_linked)
        message(STATUS "  Arrow Flight focused test: Arrow Flight library not detected, build may fail if analytics/arrow_flight.cpp requires native symbols")
    endif()

    target_compile_definitions(test_arrow_flight_focused PRIVATE
        THEMIS_TEST_BUILD=1
    )

    add_test(NAME ArrowFlightFocusedTests COMMAND test_arrow_flight_focused)

    set_tests_properties(ArrowFlightFocusedTests PROPERTIES
        LABELS "analytics;arrow;flight;rpc;focused;unit"
        TIMEOUT 120
    )

    message(STATUS "  ArrowFlight: in-process registry, FlightDescriptor, put/get, client round-trip")
endif()

# ============================================================================
# Geo Module - Focused Standalone Test Targets
# Each geo test is a standalone executable so it can be run independently
# without requiring a full themis_tests build.  All tests run in CPU-only
# simulation mode by default; CUDA/HIP variants are gated on THEMIS_GEO_CUDA
# and THEMIS_GEO_HIP respectively.
# ============================================================================

function(add_geo_focused_test target_name test_src test_name labels description)
    if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${test_src}")
        message(STATUS "Adding Geo focused test: ${target_name}")

        add_executable(${target_name}
            ${test_src}
        )

        target_include_directories(${target_name} PRIVATE
            ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/include
            ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src
        )

        target_link_libraries(${target_name} PRIVATE
            ${TEST_LIBS}
            themis_core
            Threads::Threads
        )

        if(TARGET themis_geo)
            target_link_libraries(${target_name} PRIVATE themis_geo)
        endif()

        if(NOT target_name STREQUAL "test_gpu_memory_oversubscription_focused")
            target_compile_definitions(${target_name} PRIVATE
                THEMIS_TEST_BUILD=1
            )
        endif()

        if(THEMIS_GEO_CUDA)
            target_compile_definitions(${target_name} PRIVATE THEMIS_GEO_CUDA)
        endif()

        if(THEMIS_GEO_HIP)
            target_compile_definitions(${target_name} PRIVATE THEMIS_GEO_HIP)
        endif()

        add_test(NAME ${test_name} COMMAND ${target_name})

        set_tests_properties(${test_name} PROPERTIES
            LABELS "${labels}"
            TIMEOUT 120
        )

        message(STATUS "  ${description}")
    else()
        message(STATUS "Geo focused test not found: ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${test_src}")
    endif()
endfunction()

add_geo_focused_test(
    test_geo_rtree_focused
    geo/test_geo_rtree.cpp
    GeoRtreeFocusedTests
    "geo;rtree;spatial-index;focused;unit"
    "GeoRTree: insert, nearest-neighbor, range query, bulk insert, memory footprint"
)

# Helper function to create a focused chimera test executable.
function(add_chimera_focused_test target_name test_src test_name labels description)
    set(_chimera_test_src "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${test_src}")
    if(NOT EXISTS "${_chimera_test_src}")
        set(_chimera_test_src "${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/external/chimera/tests/${test_src}")
    endif()

    if(EXISTS "${_chimera_test_src}")
        message(STATUS "Adding CHIMERA focused test: ${target_name}")

        add_executable(${target_name}
            ${_chimera_test_src}
            ${CHIMERA_ADAPTER_SOURCES}
        )

        target_include_directories(${target_name} PRIVATE
            ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/include
            ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/tests/chimera
            ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/external/chimera/include
            ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/external/chimera/tests/chimera
            ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/include
            ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/tests/chimera
        )

        target_link_libraries(${target_name} PRIVATE
            ${TEST_LIBS}
            Threads::Threads
        )

        target_compile_definitions(${target_name} PRIVATE
            THEMIS_TEST_BUILD=1
        )

        if(target_name STREQUAL "test_chimera_adapter_config_validation")
            set(_CHIMERA_CFG_RUNTIME_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/chimera_config_validation")
            file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${_CHIMERA_CFG_RUNTIME_DIR}")
            set_target_properties(${target_name} PROPERTIES
                EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL TRUE
                RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${_CHIMERA_CFG_RUNTIME_DIR}"
                PDB_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${_CHIMERA_CFG_RUNTIME_DIR}"
                ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${_CHIMERA_CFG_RUNTIME_DIR}"
                OUTPUT_NAME "test_chimera_adapter_config_validation_run"
            )
        endif()

        add_test(NAME ${test_name} COMMAND ${target_name})

        set_tests_properties(${test_name} PROPERTIES
            LABELS "${labels}"
            TIMEOUT 60
        )

        message(STATUS "  ${description}")
    else()
        message(STATUS "CHIMERA focused test not found: ${test_src}")
    endif()
endfunction()

# Helper function to create an exporters focused test executable.
function(add_exporter_focused_test target_name test_src test_name labels description)
    if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${test_src}")
        message(STATUS "Adding exporters focused test: ${target_name}")

        add_executable(${target_name}
            ${test_src}
            ${EXPORTER_CORE_SOURCES}
        )

        target_include_directories(${target_name} PRIVATE
            ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/include
            ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src
        )

        # Link themis_core when available to satisfy transitive deps
        # (AQL parser/evaluator, utils, compression libraries, Arrow/Parquet).
        set(_exporter_test_libs ${TEST_LIBS} spdlog::spdlog nlohmann_json::nlohmann_json Threads::Threads)
        if(TARGET themis_core)
            list(APPEND _exporter_test_libs themis_core)
        endif()
        if(TARGET OpenSSL::Crypto)
            list(APPEND _exporter_test_libs OpenSSL::Crypto)
        endif()

        target_link_libraries(${target_name} PRIVATE ${_exporter_test_libs})

        target_compile_definitions(${target_name} PRIVATE
            THEMIS_TEST_BUILD=1
        )

        add_test(NAME ${test_name} COMMAND ${target_name})

        set_tests_properties(${test_name} PROPERTIES
            LABELS "${labels}"
            TIMEOUT 120
        )

        message(STATUS "  ${description}")
    else()
        message(STATUS "Exporters focused test not found: ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${test_src}")
    endif()
endfunction()

# ============================================================================
# LLM Module Focused Tests (tests/llm/)
# ============================================================================

function(add_llm_focused_test target_name test_src test_name labels description)
    set(full_path "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${test_src}")
    if(NOT EXISTS "${full_path}")
        message(STATUS "LLM focused test not found: ${full_path}")
        return()
    endif()

    message(STATUS "Adding LLM focused test: ${target_name}")

    add_executable(${target_name} ${test_src})

    if(target_name STREQUAL "test_llm_ai_orchestrator")
        target_sources(${target_name} PRIVATE
            ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/llm/ai_orchestrator.cpp
            ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/llm/mode_spec_loader.cpp
        )
    endif()

    if(target_name STREQUAL "test_llm_mcp_orchestrator_bridge")
        target_sources(${target_name} PRIVATE
            ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/llm/mode_spec_loader.cpp
        )
    endif()

    if(target_name STREQUAL "test_llm_deployment_plugin")
        target_sources(${target_name} PRIVATE
            ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/llm/llm_deployment_plugin.cpp
        )
    endif()

    if(target_name STREQUAL "test_llm_kernel_fusion_cpu_fallback")
        target_sources(${target_name} PRIVATE
            ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/llm/kernel_fusion.cpp
        )
    endif()

    if(target_name STREQUAL "test_llm_real_embeddings")
        target_sources(${target_name} PRIVATE
            ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/llm/lora_framework/embedding_provider.cpp
        )
    endif()

    target_include_directories(${target_name} PRIVATE
        ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/include
        ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/include
    )

    if(TARGET themis_llm)
        target_link_libraries(${target_name} PRIVATE
            ${TEST_LIBS}
            themis_llm
            spdlog::spdlog
            nlohmann_json::nlohmann_json
            OpenSSL::SSL
            OpenSSL::Crypto
            Threads::Threads
        )
        # Also link themis_core when available so LLM tests can use cross-module
        # types such as PolicyEngine (governance) without separate link steps.
        if(TARGET themis_core)
            target_link_libraries(${target_name} PRIVATE themis_core)
        endif()
    else()
        target_link_libraries(${target_name} PRIVATE
            ${TEST_LIBS}
            themis_core
            spdlog::spdlog
            nlohmann_json::nlohmann_json
            OpenSSL::SSL
            OpenSSL::Crypto
            Threads::Threads
        )
    endif()

    if(target_name STREQUAL "test_llm_ai_orchestrator" AND TARGET yaml-cpp::yaml-cpp)
        target_link_libraries(${target_name} PRIVATE yaml-cpp::yaml-cpp)
    endif()

    if(target_name STREQUAL "test_llm_mcp_orchestrator_bridge" AND TARGET yaml-cpp::yaml-cpp)
        target_link_libraries(${target_name} PRIVATE yaml-cpp::yaml-cpp)
    endif()

    # Boost (Beast/ASIO) is used by server headers included from some LLM tests.
    if(Boost_FOUND)
        target_link_libraries(${target_name} PRIVATE Boost::system)
    endif()

    target_compile_definitions(${target_name} PRIVATE
        THEMIS_TEST_BUILD=1
        THEMIS_LLM_EXPORTS
    )

    add_test(NAME ${test_name} COMMAND ${target_name})

    set_tests_properties(${test_name} PROPERTIES
        LABELS "${labels}"
        TIMEOUT 120
    )

    message(STATUS "  ${description}")
endfunction()

# Helper macro for ingestion focused tests
macro(add_ingestion_focused_test TARGET_NAME TEST_SOURCE TEST_NAME LABELS DESCRIPTION)
    if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${TEST_SOURCE}")
        message(STATUS "Adding ingestion focused test: ${TARGET_NAME}")

        add_executable(${TARGET_NAME}
            ${TEST_SOURCE}
        )

        # Ingestion sources are in themis_core; if building without themis_core
        # (standalone), add them explicitly to avoid missing-symbol errors.
        if(NOT TARGET themis_core)
            target_sources(${TARGET_NAME} PRIVATE ${INGESTION_CORE_SOURCES})
        endif()

        target_include_directories(${TARGET_NAME} PRIVATE
            ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/include
            ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src
        )

        target_link_libraries(${TARGET_NAME} PRIVATE
            ${TEST_LIBS}
            $<$<TARGET_EXISTS:themis_core>:themis_core>
            Threads::Threads
        )

        target_compile_definitions(${TARGET_NAME} PRIVATE
            THEMIS_TEST_BUILD=1
        )

        add_test(NAME ${TEST_NAME} COMMAND ${TARGET_NAME})

        set_tests_properties(${TEST_NAME} PROPERTIES
            LABELS "${LABELS}"
            TIMEOUT 120
        )

        message(STATUS "  ${DESCRIPTION}")
    else()
        message(STATUS "Ingestion test not found: ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${TEST_SOURCE}")
    endif()
endmacro()

# ============================================================================
# Network Module - Focused Standalone Test Targets
# Standalone executables so each network component can be tested in isolation
# without linking the full themis_core library.
# ============================================================================

# Helper macro to create a standalone network focused test executable.
# Usage:
#   add_network_focused_test(<target> <src> <test_name> "<labels>" "<desc>" [LIBS ...])
macro(add_network_focused_test target src test_name labels desc)
    if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${src}")
        message(STATUS "Adding Network focused test: ${target}")

        add_executable(${target} ${src})

        if("${target}" STREQUAL "test_udp_server_focused")
            target_sources(${target} PRIVATE
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/network/udp_server.cpp
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/utils/logger.cpp
            )
            target_link_libraries(${target} PRIVATE spdlog::spdlog fmt::fmt)
        endif()

        target_include_directories(${target} PRIVATE
            ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/include
            ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/include
        )

        target_link_libraries(${target} PRIVATE
            ${TEST_LIBS}
            themis_core
            Threads::Threads
        )

        target_compile_definitions(${target} PRIVATE
            THEMIS_TEST_BUILD=1
        )

        add_test(NAME ${test_name} COMMAND ${target})

        set_tests_properties(${test_name} PROPERTIES
            LABELS "${labels}"
            TIMEOUT 60
        )

        message(STATUS "  ${desc}")
    else()
        message(STATUS "Network focused test not found: ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${src}")
    endif()
endmacro()

# Prompt Engineering Module - Standalone Focused Test Targets
# Each target is an independent executable so individual components can be
# validated in isolation without linking the entire themis_tests binary.
# All targets compile against themis_core only; no live database is required.
# ============================================================================

# Helper macro shared by all prompt_engineering focused targets.
# Usage: add_prompt_focused_test(<target> <src> <test_name> <labels> <desc>)
macro(add_prompt_focused_test _target _src _test_name _labels _desc)
    if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${_src}")
        message(STATUS "Adding Prompt Engineering focused test: ${_target}")

        add_executable(${_target} ${_src})

        target_include_directories(${_target} PRIVATE
            ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/include
            ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src
        )

        target_link_libraries(${_target} PRIVATE
            ${TEST_LIBS}
            themis_core
            nlohmann_json::nlohmann_json
            spdlog::spdlog
            Threads::Threads
        )

        target_compile_definitions(${_target} PRIVATE
            THEMIS_TEST_BUILD=1
        )

        add_test(NAME ${_test_name} COMMAND ${_target})

        set_tests_properties(${_test_name} PROPERTIES
            LABELS "${_labels}"
            TIMEOUT 120
        )

        message(STATUS "  ${_test_name}: ${_desc}")
    else()
        message(STATUS "Prompt Engineering focused test not found: ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${_src}")
    endif()
endmacro()

# ============================================================================
# Index Module Focused Tests (Issue: #1882 - unit test coverage >80%)
# Each test is a standalone executable covering a specific index subsystem.
# ============================================================================

function(add_index_focused_test target_name test_src test_name labels description)
    if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${test_src}")
        message(STATUS "Adding Index focused test: ${target_name}")

        add_executable(${target_name}
            ${test_src}
        )

        if(target_name STREQUAL "test_gpu_memory_oversubscription_focused")
            target_sources(${target_name} PRIVATE
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/index/gpu_memory_oversubscription.cpp
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/index/gpu_vector_index.cpp
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/gpu/gpu_memory_manager_edition.cpp
            )
        endif()

        target_include_directories(${target_name} PRIVATE
            ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/include
            ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src
        )

        target_link_libraries(${target_name} PRIVATE
            ${TEST_LIBS}
            themis_core
            Threads::Threads
        )

        if(TARGET themis_storage)
            target_link_libraries(${target_name} PRIVATE themis_storage)
        endif()

        target_compile_definitions(${target_name} PRIVATE
            THEMIS_TEST_BUILD=1
        )

        add_test(NAME ${test_name} COMMAND ${target_name})

        set_tests_properties(${test_name} PROPERTIES
            LABELS "${labels}"
            TIMEOUT 120
        )

        message(STATUS "  ${description}")
    else()
        message(STATUS "Index focused test not found: ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${test_src}")
    endif()
endfunction()

# ============================================================================
# Enabled when THEMIS_ENABLE_OPENCL is set (or the cmake find_package
# for OpenCL succeeds).  Uses pocl-opencl-icd in CI for a CPU-only OpenCL
# device so the GPU-assisted paths can be exercised without real hardware.
if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/opencl/test_opencl_erasure_coder_parity.cpp"
        AND NOT TARGET test_opencl_erasure_coder_parity_focused)

    # Try to locate an OpenCL SDK (headers + ICD loader)
    find_package(OpenCL QUIET)

    if(OpenCL_FOUND OR THEMIS_ENABLE_OPENCL)
        message(STATUS "Adding Sharding: OpenCL ErasureCoder parity tests (Issue #105)")

        add_executable(test_opencl_erasure_coder_parity_focused
            opencl/test_opencl_erasure_coder_parity.cpp
            ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/sharding/gpu_erasure_coder_opencl.cpp
        )

        target_include_directories(test_opencl_erasure_coder_parity_focused PRIVATE
            ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/include
            ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src
            ${OpenCL_INCLUDE_DIRS}
        )

        target_link_libraries(test_opencl_erasure_coder_parity_focused PRIVATE
            ${TEST_LIBS}
            themis_core
            spdlog::spdlog
            Threads::Threads
        )

        if(TARGET OpenCL::OpenCL)
            target_link_libraries(test_opencl_erasure_coder_parity_focused PRIVATE OpenCL::OpenCL)
        elseif(OpenCL_LIBRARIES)
            target_link_libraries(test_opencl_erasure_coder_parity_focused PRIVATE ${OpenCL_LIBRARIES})
        elseif(WIN32)
            target_link_libraries(test_opencl_erasure_coder_parity_focused PRIVATE OpenCL)
        endif()

        target_compile_definitions(test_opencl_erasure_coder_parity_focused PRIVATE
            THEMIS_TEST_BUILD=1
            THEMIS_ENABLE_OPENCL=1
        )

        add_test(NAME OpenCLErasureCoderParityTests
            COMMAND test_opencl_erasure_coder_parity_focused)

        set_tests_properties(OpenCLErasureCoderParityTests PROPERTIES
            LABELS "sharding;gpu;opencl;erasure-coding;reed-solomon;parity;v1.8.0;focused;unit"
            TIMEOUT 120
        )

        message(STATUS "  OpenCLErasureCoder: encode/decode round-trip 1/2/3 erasures, CPU/GPU parity, batchEncode")
    else()
        message(STATUS "OpenCL SDK not found - OpenCL ErasureCoder parity tests will be skipped")
    endif()
endif()

if(TARGET themis_tests)
    get_target_property(_themis_tests_sources_final themis_tests SOURCES)
    if(_themis_tests_sources_final)
        list(FILTER _themis_tests_sources_final EXCLUDE REGEX ".*[\\/]src[\\/]importers[\\/]postgres_importer\\.cpp$")
        list(FILTER _themis_tests_sources_final EXCLUDE REGEX ".*[\\/]src[\\/]importers[\\/]postgres_importer_mdm\\.cpp$")
        # Remove any source file entries that do not exist on disk to avoid
        # configure-time errors when optional test modules are not yet present.
        set(_themis_tests_sources_verified)
        foreach(_src IN LISTS _themis_tests_sources_final)
            if(EXISTS "${_src}")
                list(APPEND _themis_tests_sources_verified "${_src}")
            endif()
        endforeach()
        set_property(TARGET themis_tests PROPERTY SOURCES ${_themis_tests_sources_verified})
    endif()
endif()

# Cross-Module: German e-Government Connector Chain
# eID (auth) → OZG Service Registry (importers) → XOEV Importer (importers)
# → XDOMEA Connector (document) - integration tests
#
# Group A (5 tests): eID × OZG - authenticated citizen looks up OZG service
#   A-1: Successful auth → OZG lookup by ID
#   A-2: eID failure short-circuits; no OZG access
#   A-3: eID identity attributes available for OZG compliance context
#   A-4: OZG SDG-relevant flag accessible after auth
#   A-5: Revoked session cannot be reused
# Group B (4 tests): OZG × XOEV - service metadata drives XOEV records
#   B-1: XOEV XBau record fields match OZG service fim_process_id
#   B-2: OZG compliance_tags align with XOEVStandard::XBAU
#   B-3: OZG field names match XOEV record field keys
#   B-4: XOEV import for unknown OZG service is detectable
# Group C (4 tests): XOEV × XDOMEA - XOEV records produce XDOMEA documents
#   C-1: Single XOEV record → XDOMEA Dokument
#   C-2: Multiple XOEV records → Akte + N children
#   C-3: XDOMEA round-trip preserves betreff/aktenzeichen from XOEV
#   C-4: XOEV record count == XDOMEA document count after full pipeline
# Group D (3 tests): Full chain
#   D-1: Baugenehmigung application end-to-end (eID→OZG→XOEV→XDOMEA)
#   D-2: eID failure short-circuits entire chain
#   D-3: Each chain step returns the correct module-specific result type
# ============================================================================

                themis_core

            DISCOVERY_MODE PRE_TEST
            WORKING_DIRECTORY $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:${_name}>
            EXTRA_ARGS --gtest_color=yes
            CONFIGURATIONS Release Debug
        )
    endmacro()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Systemic LNK2005 fix: remove logger.cpp from focused test targets
#
# In a modular build, logger symbols are exported by themis_base.dll and
# imported via __declspec(dllimport) by all consumers.  Focused test targets
# that also compile logger.cpp directly cause LNK2005 (duplicate symbols).
#
# Exception: themis_tests sets THEMIS_BASE_EXPORTS + /FORCE:MULTIPLE and
# deliberately compiles logger.cpp to provide the definitions — leave it.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
get_directory_property(_focused_test_targets BUILDSYSTEM_TARGETS)
set(_logger_src_variants
    "${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/utils/logger.cpp"
    "${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/utils/logger.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../src/utils/logger.cpp"
    "../src/utils/logger.cpp"
)
foreach(_tgt IN LISTS _focused_test_targets)
    if(_tgt STREQUAL "themis_tests" OR _tgt STREQUAL "test_websocket_cdc_focused")
        continue()
    endif()
    get_target_property(_tgt_type ${_tgt} TYPE)
    if(NOT _tgt_type STREQUAL "EXECUTABLE")
        continue()
    endif()
    # Remove logger.cpp (Logger symbols come via dllimport from themis_base)
    get_target_property(_tgt_srcs ${_tgt} SOURCES)
    if(_tgt_srcs)
        set(_compiles_logger FALSE)
        foreach(_variant IN LISTS _logger_src_variants)
            if("${_variant}" IN_LIST _tgt_srcs)
                set(_compiles_logger TRUE)
                break()
            endif()
        endforeach()

        # Targets that do not compile logger.cpp must import Logger symbols
        # from themis_base/themis_core rather than exporting them locally.
        if(NOT _compiles_logger)
            get_target_property(_tgt_defs ${_tgt} COMPILE_DEFINITIONS)
            if(_tgt_defs)
                list(REMOVE_ITEM _tgt_defs "THEMIS_TEST_BUILD" "THEMIS_TEST_BUILD=1")
                set_property(TARGET ${_tgt} PROPERTY COMPILE_DEFINITIONS ${_tgt_defs})
            endif()
        endif()

        set(_logger_removed FALSE)
        foreach(_variant IN LISTS _logger_src_variants)
            if("${_variant}" IN_LIST _tgt_srcs)
                list(REMOVE_ITEM _tgt_srcs "${_variant}")
                set(_logger_removed TRUE)
            endif()
        endforeach()
        if(_logger_removed)
            set_property(TARGET ${_tgt} PROPERTY SOURCES ${_tgt_srcs})
            message(STATUS "${_tgt}: removed logger.cpp (Logger dllimport via themis_base)")

            # logger.cpp is no longer compiled into this target, therefore
            # Logger must be imported from themis_base (dllimport path).
            get_target_property(_tgt_defs ${_tgt} COMPILE_DEFINITIONS)
            if(_tgt_defs)
                list(REMOVE_ITEM _tgt_defs "THEMIS_TEST_BUILD" "THEMIS_TEST_BUILD=1")
                set_property(TARGET ${_tgt} PROPERTY COMPILE_DEFINITIONS ${_tgt_defs})
            endif()
        endif()
        # If the target compiles olap.cpp directly it also needs themis_core
        # linked (for GPUQueryAccelerator + GPUGraphCache transitive deps).
        # /FORCE:MULTIPLE (applied below) suppresses the resulting LNK2005.
        set(_olap_src "${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/analytics/olap.cpp")
        if("${_olap_src}" IN_LIST _tgt_srcs)
            get_target_property(_existing_libs ${_tgt} LINK_LIBRARIES)
            if(NOT _existing_libs OR NOT "themis_core" IN_LIST _existing_libs)
                target_link_libraries(${_tgt} PRIVATE themis_core)
                message(STATUS "${_tgt}: added themis_core link (required by olap.cpp GPU deps)")
            endif()
        endif()
    endif()
    # Apply /FORCE:MULTIPLE to suppress LNK2005 when source files compiled
    # directly are also present in a linked static library (e.g. via Unity build
    # in themis_network or themis_core).  The directly compiled .obj takes
    # precedence; the duplicate from the static lib is silently discarded.
    target_link_options(${_tgt} PRIVATE
        $<$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:MSVC>:/FORCE:MULTIPLE>
    )
    # Ensure every focused executable has the baseline runtime libs it needs:
    #   themis_base  – Logger dllimport symbols
    #   spdlog/fmt   – logging backend
    get_target_property(_existing_libs ${_tgt} LINK_LIBRARIES)
    if(NOT _existing_libs OR NOT "themis_base" IN_LIST _existing_libs)
        target_link_libraries(${_tgt} PRIVATE themis_base)
    endif()
    if(TARGET spdlog::spdlog)
        if(NOT _existing_libs OR NOT "spdlog::spdlog" IN_LIST _existing_libs)
            target_link_libraries(${_tgt} PRIVATE spdlog::spdlog)
        endif()
    endif()
    if(TARGET fmt::fmt)
        if(NOT _existing_libs OR NOT "fmt::fmt" IN_LIST _existing_libs)
            target_link_libraries(${_tgt} PRIVATE fmt::fmt)
        endif()
    endif()
endforeach()
unset(_focused_test_targets)
unset(_logger_src_variants)
unset(_compiles_logger)
unset(_tgt_srcs)
unset(_logger_removed)

# =========================================================================
# Tensor Network Module — focused test targets (Phase 1–6)
# Added 2026-05-07
# Each target links against themis_core which now includes all tensor sources
# via cmake/StorageEnhancements.cmake (Tensor Network Module section).
# =========================================================================

# Helper macro for tensor focused tests
macro(_tensor_focused_test _name)
    if(EXISTS "${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/tests/${_name}.cpp" AND NOT TARGET ${_name}_focused)
        add_executable(${_name}_focused
            ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/tests/${_name}.cpp
        )
        if("${_name}" STREQUAL "test_gguf_metadata")
            target_sources(${_name}_focused PRIVATE
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/storage/gguf_metadata.cpp
            )
        elseif("${_name}" STREQUAL "test_adalora_tt_bridge")
            target_sources(${_name}_focused PRIVATE
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/training/ada_lora_adapter.cpp
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/training/adalora_tt_bridge.cpp
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/graph/tensor_fingerprint_graph.cpp
            )
        elseif("${_name}" STREQUAL "test_tensor_hiss_structural_search")
            target_sources(${_name}_focused PRIVATE
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/tensor/tnsr_task.cpp
            )
        elseif("${_name}" STREQUAL "test_tensor_utr")
            target_sources(${_name}_focused PRIVATE
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/tensor/utr_converter.cpp
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/tensor/hyper_index_builder.cpp
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/storage/hierarchical_tucker_decomposer.cpp
            )
        elseif("${_name}" STREQUAL "test_tensor_ht")
            target_sources(${_name}_focused PRIVATE
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/storage/hierarchical_tucker_decomposer.cpp
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/tensor/ht_index.cpp
            )
        elseif("${_name}" STREQUAL "test_tensor_recompress")
            target_sources(${_name}_focused PRIVATE
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/storage/tensor_compaction_filter.cpp
            )
        elseif("${_name}" STREQUAL "test_tensor_phase3")
            target_sources(${_name}_focused PRIVATE
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/query/tensor_aware_query_optimizer.cpp
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/rag/targ_retrieval.cpp
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/rag/flare_retrieval.cpp
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/rag/tensor_rag_pipeline.cpp
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/storage/tensor_compaction_filter.cpp
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/tensor/tensor_butterfly_operator.cpp
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/tensor/tensor_fingerprint_graph.cpp
                ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src/tensor/adapter_repository.cpp
            )
        endif()
        target_link_libraries(${_name}_focused
            PRIVATE themis_core GTest::gtest GTest::gtest_main
        )
        gtest_discover_tests(${_name}_focused
            DISCOVERY_MODE PRE_TEST
            WORKING_DIRECTORY $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:${_name}_focused>
            EXTRA_ARGS --gtest_color=yes
        )
    endif()
endmacro()

        WORKING_DIRECTORY $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:test_multi_task_lora_ablation_focused>
        EXTRA_ARGS --gtest_color=yes
    )

    message(STATUS "  MultiTaskLoRAAblation: MTL-ABL-01..07 (joint loss, balanced weights, 3-task, avg_improvement, weight sizes)")

# G003: Error Handling & Thread Safety remediation tests
# EHS-01..EHS-08 + TSF-01..TSF-08 + RVC-01..RVC-04
# Issue: GAP-SCAN-2026-06-21 G003
# ============================================================================

if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/test_g003_error_handling_thread_safety.cpp")
    message(STATUS "Adding G003 error-handling & thread-safety tests (EHS-01..08, TSF-01..08, RVC-01..04)")

    add_executable(test_g003_error_handling_thread_safety_focused
        test_g003_error_handling_thread_safety.cpp
    )

    target_include_directories(test_g003_error_handling_thread_safety_focused PRIVATE
        ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/include
        ${THEMIS_ROOT_DIR}/src
    )

    target_link_libraries(test_g003_error_handling_thread_safety_focused PRIVATE
        GTest::gtest
        GTest::gtest_main
        Threads::Threads
    )

    target_compile_definitions(test_g003_error_handling_thread_safety_focused PRIVATE
        THEMIS_TEST_BUILD=1
    )

    # DISCOVERY_MODE POST_BUILD ensures tests are registered at build time so that
    # PROPERTIES can be applied correctly.  PRE_TEST defers discovery to run time,
    # which breaks set_tests_properties at configure time (pre-existing issue fixed here).
    gtest_discover_tests(test_g003_error_handling_thread_safety_focused
        DISCOVERY_MODE POST_BUILD
        WORKING_DIRECTORY $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:test_g003_error_handling_thread_safety_focused>
        EXTRA_ARGS --gtest_color=yes
        PROPERTIES
            LABELS "error_handling;thread_safety;g003;reliability;release_critical"
            TIMEOUT 60
    )

    message(STATUS "  G003: EHS-01..08 (exception safety), TSF-01..08 (thread safety), RVC-01..04 (return value checks)")
endif()
